Body.Content: Sensors on an assembly line, cars driving down the freeway, gamers playing the latest viral success—the proliferation of Internet-connected devices and event-driven services is creating an ever-increasing number of scenarios where you need to gather information and send messages back to many thousands, or even millions, of devices. Azure Event Hubs helps solve data flow challenges where you want to ingest, persist, and process millions of events per second. With updated Service Bus Queues and Topics messaging tiers, customers will now be able to utilize Queues and Topics for large-scale IoT Command & Control scenarios along with Event Hubs. For more information, visit the Event Hubs page. For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Event Hubs Pricing page.
Body.Markdown:
Sensors on an assembly line, cars driving down the freeway, gamers playing the latest viral success—the proliferation of Internet-connected devices and event-driven services is creating an ever-increasing number of scenarios where you need to gather information and send messages back to many thousands, or even millions, of devices. Azure Event Hubs helps solve data flow challenges where you want to ingest, persist, and process millions of events per second.

With updated Service Bus Queues and Topics messaging tiers, customers will now be able to utilize Queues and Topics for large-scale IoT Command & Control scenarios along with Event Hubs.

For more information, visit the Event Hubs page. For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Event Hubs Pricing page.
